items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: And then Dick Hyman calls for 92nd Street Y.

ctx.x: One avenue dries up but something else will hopefully replace it.

Yeah. And musically I like to plug in to different projects. I think that’s why when I tried a little Broadway thing I got bored very quickly. When I did some legit work, a little tympani or snare drum, and I have utmost respect for it and I love it, but I get bored quickly. And it’s probably my problem. But I don’t think it’s a problem. What I think it is is I like the spontaneity of the moment and the challenge of the project at hand. So whether it’s a gig or a two week engagement or a tour or a festival or a…
